pr_title: tests: posix: use new ztest api
pr_body:
For each suite in `tests/posix/`
* Convert test suite declaration to `ZTEST_SUITE()` and test case declaration to `ZTEST()`.
* add `CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y` to prj.conf

Fixes #46793

Created https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/46897 to rework `tests/posix/fs` when new ztest features are available.
